---
title: "Start here"
---

Catchment Lake is read anonymously — no account, no token — through
[DuckDB's Iceberg extension](https://duckdb.org/docs/extensions/iceberg.html).
Every client below speaks that same SQL underneath; pick the one you already
use.

## The one statement every client needs

```sql
INSTALL iceberg; LOAD iceberg;
ATTACH 'canceronice' AS coi (
    TYPE ICEBERG,
    URI 'https://icegate-canceronice.seandavi.workers.dev',  -- DuckDB <= 1.5: ENDPOINT instead of URI
    AUTHORIZATION_TYPE 'none'
);
```

DuckDB versions through 1.5 (and the pinned build the in-browser recipes use)
only accept `ENDPOINT`; newer native builds warn that `ENDPOINT` is
deprecated and prefer `URI`. Use whichever your DuckDB version asks for — the
value is the same either way.

Once attached, every table is `coi.<namespace>.<table>` — `coi.measure.observation`,
`coi.geography.unit`, and so on. See the [Dictionary](/dictionary/index.qmd)
for the full table and column list.

## Pick your client

- [Python](python.qmd) — the `duckdb` package, worked examples
- [DuckDB CLI](duckdb-cli.qmd) — no install beyond the `duckdb` binary itself
- [R](r.qmd)
- [SAS](sas.qmd)
- [SEER\*Stat](seerstat.qmd)

`value` is `NULL` whenever `value_status` is not `'reported'` — see
[Concepts › Suppression](/concepts/suppression.qmd) before you filter or
aggregate a measure.
